describe: Onboarding 'Learning Setup' step. Backdrop is an illustrated pastel-lavender futuristic city skyline with a ringed planet and clouds, plus a glowing circular holographic platform at lower left carrying a miniature neon city model with small holographic signs - all backdrop. Two separate characters stand behind the platform and do NOT touch: a cartoon boy in a blue jacket with an orange backpack (hair top y=371, pointing hand to x=308, right hair tuft to x=330, body occluded by the platform below y~710) and, about 45px to his right across a holographic castle, the white-and-blue robot Nova (antenna ball top y=417, extended left hand x=360, right elbow x=594). UI to erase: the Kidsverse+ logo lockup top-left, the 4-step progress stepper top-centre, the English language chip top-right, the headline 'Set the learning path' in its own box, the two-line subtitle below it, the SELECT GRADE card with the 1-6 grade tiles and hint panel, the SELECT BOARD card with CBSE/ICSE/Other rows, the verified badge and hint panel, and the bottom action bar holding Back and CONTINUE.
